name: NRP CAD
install:
export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"
export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"
if ! command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash
  export PATH="$HOME/.bun/bin:$PATH"
fi
bun install

terminals.name: NRP CAD Live Preview
terminals.command: export BUN_INSTALL="$HOME/.bun"; export PATH="$BUN_INSTALL/bin:$PATH"; OPEN_BROWSER=0 bun run dev:live
terminals.description: Northpoint CAD on port 5173 — UI from this repo, API on Render (Supabase Postgres), Discord counts from Supabase public-stats.
